fusions.name: Gnaw Through
fusions.desc: A gnawing bite that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Devouring Cloud
fusions.desc: Deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Swarm Muster
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud for 15 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Plague Hatch
fusions.desc: Calls a locust cloud familiar that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving its target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.
